# Outputs Directory

This directory is the centralized location for all generated assets, charts, and benchmark results produced by the evaluation scripts.

## Directory Structure
*   `phase1/`: Contains SSD throughput JSON results from `fio` and the corresponding generated graphs from `utils/plot_phase1.py`.
*   `phase2/`: Contains the Needle-In-A-Haystack accuracy evaluation JSON results.
*   `phase3/`: Contains the simulation JSON results and final Pareto and tradeoff charts generated by `utils/plot_phase3.py`.
